label: Holders of the joint-absence power are actual roots, from P2', P3', presence and NAR
meaning: Let y hold the power. By P3' it is concrete; by the existence premise it exists at w. For an accessible v, by excluded middle y exists at v or not; if not, y is contingent at w, but P2' puts y at an accessible world where every concrete being contingent at w is absent, a contradiction. So y is NECESSARY_2 at w, and NAR makes it an actual root of G at w.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `F.history.ontic.ExistsAt v y` (in holder_necessary). LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
